Garage description
For the tanker who wants to go beyond using bullets and venture into the realm of chemical tetanus-powered warfare, the "Corrosion" paint is the perfect companion.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on July 29, 2010.
Before the Paint Separation Update, Corrosion was worth 34,500 crystals and could be bought from  Warrant Officer 3
Legacy paint description:
A paint that provides average protection against Railgun, Thunder, and Shaft. Great for mid to long-range battles. It covers the tank in an even layer of rust.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
